concept: SCP: prevent disabling CloudTrail across the organization
tests: Which control prevents even a member-account admin from stopping CloudTrail or deleting logs across the entire Organization.
expected: SCP with an explicit Deny on cloudtrail:StopLogging, DeleteTrail, etc. — an SCP sets the maximum permissions and overrides any Allow in the account, including admins. Triggers: "across the entire Organization", "even if granted admin in a member account".
why_not: A permissions boundary is set per principal and can be removed by the account admin; a bucket policy and MFA do not prevent stopping the trail itself.
